name: Lighthouses
description: Lighthouses word search puzzles gather beacon and shore English for adults — lamp, tower, foghorn, harbor, lantern and calm coastal words — without tourist slogans or brand names. Play free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No account and no timer: just steady coastal vocabulary many seaside walkers already know. Short words such as fog, rock and glow hide along edges; longer anchors like channel, gallery and lantern steady harder grids. This hub sits under Ocean and pairs well with Islands, Lakes, Travel and National Parks when cliffs meet trails. Prefer bigger letters? Choose large print. New solvers can read how to play, then follow the beam across the grid.
